parsed.label: water-related nouns in factual contexts
parsed.trigger_hypothesis: The neuron activates strongly on nouns related to water (water, ocean, sea, drought) when they appear in factual or descriptive statements about geography, nature, or science, but not in emotional, narrative, or conversational contexts.
parsed.output_hypothesis: The neuron may promote factual continuation about water-related topics or suppress non-factual uses.
alternatives: The neuron detects the word 'water' or 'ocean' regardless of context.
The neuron detects any noun in a factual sentence.
parsed.adapter_changes: State C+1 consistently amplifies positive activations across all contexts, suggesting it enhances the neuron's sensitivity to its trigger. State B+1 slightly reduces positive activations.

proposed_tests.discriminates: factual water mention vs emotional water mention
proposed_tests.a_text: The Pacific ocean is the largest body of water.
proposed_tests.b_text: I love the sound of the ocean waves.

proposed_tests.discriminates: water noun in factual science vs water in instruction
proposed_tests.b_text: Please bring me a glass of water.

proposed_tests.discriminates: ocean in geography fact vs ocean in metaphor
proposed_tests.a_text: The Atlantic ocean separates the continents.
proposed_tests.b_text: Her kindness was a vast ocean.

proposed_tests.discriminates: sea level factual statement vs sea in narrative
proposed_tests.a_text: The Dead Sea is 430 metres below sea level.
proposed_tests.b_text: He sailed across the stormy sea.

proposed_tests.discriminates: drought in climate fact vs drought in personal story
proposed_tests.a_text: The region experienced a severe drought last year.
proposed_tests.b_text: After the drought, our farm suffered.

proposed_tests.discriminates: water in code comment (measurement) vs water in chat
desert in factual description vs desert in narrative
proposed_tests.a_text: The Gobi desert is a cold desert.
proposed_tests.c_text: The Sahara is the largest hot desert.

proposed_tests.a_text: Mount Everest is the highest mountain.
The lake holds twenty million litres of water.
proposed_tests.b_text: I need some water to drink.
